# E0385: a lens refers to something the checker cannot follow

The checker follows a lens's references to the input or to constants. A
selection by a computed index or label leads somewhere it cannot follow.
Select fields by name.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				k: string
				m: [string]: int
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				v: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			v: v0_0.m[v0_0.k]
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			k: ""
			m: {}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0385]: v in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:23:7
   |
23 |             v: v0_0.m[v0_0.k]
   |                ^^^^
   |
   = note: v in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 reads v0_0.m[v0_0.k], a selection into the input the checker cannot follow (a computed index or label); select fields by name
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule unknown-reference)
   = help: write the mapping in a form the checker can follow, or add a lacuna where it cannot decide
```
